name: smwgraphics-e-v-o-search-for-eden-underwater-cave
title: E.V.O. : Search for Eden - Underwater Cave
description:
A very dark cave background, ripped from E.V.O.: Search for the Eden. It's found in the first chapter's caves from the game. The original background uses HDMA wave effects and stuff, since it's used in an underwater cave (duh), so I recommend combining it with wave HDMA for great results. Requested by FireSeraphim.

Uses palette row 3. BG1, BG2 and BG3 slots.

Although this background gave me some trouble, credits are optional, as usual.
